TABLE.NAME: quizaccess_essayrubric
TABLE.COMMENT: How rubrics of essay with rubric questions are displayed in each quiz.

FIELD.NAME: alwaysshowdefinition
FIELD.COMMENT: Show the rubric to students before grading.

FIELD.NAME: showscorestudent
FIELD.COMMENT: Show the points for each level to students.

FIELD.NAME: enableremarks
FIELD.COMMENT: Allow graders to add a remark for each criterion.

FIELD.NAME: showscoreteacher
FIELD.COMMENT: Show the points for each level to graders.

FIELD.NAME: sortlevelsasc
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 to list levels in ascending order of points, 0 for descending.
